The city takes their work and gives them canvas. Here we have houses with new roofs and nobody to sleep under them. No rent, no taxes - only work on the palisade and a share of what we grow. Go to the camp below the south gate of Nanzhang and find Tinker Bao. Everyone there knows him. Tell him there is a roof waiting in Mossgate.
Thank you. Tell him the truth - it is hard work, and tigers at night. But nobody here will count his coins.
Then I will keep building roofs and hope someone finds them on his own.
Tinker Bao camps below the south gate of Nanzhang. Mossgate is waiting for an answer.

A roof without rent? In Mossgate? Ha... my grandfather used to talk about that place. There are six families in this camp who would carry their pots there tomorrow, and I would go with them. A village needs someone to mend its kettles - and a gate always needs hinges. Tell the hermits to expect us before the rains. Here, for your trouble - you brought better news than any customer this year.
Have you spoken with Tinker Bao yet? You will find him in the tent camp below the south gate of Nanzhang.

quests.title: Hide and Sinew
quests.mission: Collect 160 Blood Tiger Hides; Collect 80 bundles of Blood Tiger Sinew
dialog: Look around - one house with a whole roof, and a dozen without. Every stake in that fence I drove in myself, with this mallet. My husband held the walls of Nanzhang, and I held a spear right beside him. Life here is harder than any watch there - but it is ours. For the roofs I need hides, the thick hides of the Blood Tigers that hunt along the road. For the palisade I need sinew: wound wet around a stake, it dries tighter than any rope. Bring me one hundred and sixty hides and eighty bundles of sinew. They will come to you only once you agree.
Thank you. The Mystic Blood Tigers roam the old road north and south of the gates. About one in five gives a hide worth keeping, one in ten sinew strong enough for a stake.
Then the roofs will wait another season. We are used to waiting.
Not yet. One hundred and sixty hides and eighty bundles of sinew - I measured every roof twice.
Your pack is too full for what I have for you. Make some room and come back.

Look at this pile! Three more houses will have roofs before the rains, and the east fence gets new stakes. We fought for other people's walls long enough. One day, with enough roofs and enough hands, there will be children in Mossgate again. Take this, with our thanks.
You have the hides and the sinew. Return to Hermit Yuelan Sima in Mossgate.

quests.title: Grave Goods
quests.mission: Collect 60 Stolen Grave Offerings; Slay 1 Mystic Bandit Champion
dialog: Behind the village, past the old wall, lie the barrows of Mossgate. My grandparents rest there - I cleaned their stones with my own hands the day we came back. Then I found the barrows dug open. The Mystic Bandits took everything we had laid beside our dead: bowls, coins, jade amulets. Their leader stood by and told them where to dig. Bring back sixty of the stolen offerings, and put an end to the one who gave the orders. The bandits carry them in their packs - they will fall to you only once you agree.

Thank you. The bandits camp along the old road south, toward the mine. Their leader is a Champion - you will hear him before you see him. About one bandit in four still carries something from our barrows.
Then the dead will wait. They have waited for us since Hu Lan came - a little longer will not break them. It may break me.
Not yet. Sixty offerings, and the one who ordered the digging - until then my grandparents lie with empty hands.
Your pack is too full for what I have for you. Make some room and come back.

My grandmother's jade amulet... I would know it anywhere. Tonight I will put every bowl and every coin back where it belongs, and this time I will seal the barrows with stone. You did for my family what Nanzhang never did. Take this - and if you pass the barrows, stop for a moment. They know who brought their things home.
You have the offerings, and their leader is dead. Return to Hermit Yuelan Sima in Mossgate.

quests.title: How is the library coming along?
quests.mission: Conversation with Hotel Host Wang Fu
dialog: Every room on the east side is full of carpenters. They snore like oxen, but they bring good news every evening - the library is rising.

quests.title: The Library of Nanzhang
dialog: The library? Before it burned, scholars came from every province to read there - and they all slept under my father's roof. Since then my best rooms stand empty. Ledger Keeper Shen keeps the books that survived.

A library again? Then scholars will come again - and builders before them. My guest house will lodge every carpenter and stonecutter free of charge while they work. Tell Lady Shen that Wang Fu is with her.
You have won the support of Hotel Host Wang Fu.
You have won the support of Hotel Host Wang Fu.  Quest complete: Patrons of the Library. Return to Ledger Keeper Shen to receive your reward.
Quest complete: Patrons of the Library. Return to Ledger Keeper Shen to receive your reward.

quests.title: How is the library coming along?
quests.mission: Conversation with House Mother Xueer Jiamu
dialog: My ladies have already chosen the first books they want to borrow. Lady Shen will be busy.

quests.title: The Library of Nanzhang
dialog: The library that burned... I remember the smoke over the Lotus Garden. Lady Shen still guards the books that survived. A brave woman.

A library for Nanzhang? My ladies want to read too, you know - poetry, letters, the old tales. The House of Silk Lanterns will pay for the building. Tell Lady Shen she has a patron in the Night District.
I have given my word - the house will fund the building. Tell Lady Shen.

quests.title: The Library of Nanzhang
dialog: The library that burned... I remember the smoke over the Lotus Garden. Lady Shen still guards the books that survived. A brave woman.

A library for Nanzhang? My ladies want to read too, you know - poetry, letters, the old tales. The House of Silk Lanterns will pay for the building. Tell Lady Shen she has a patron in the Night District.
You have won the support of House Mother Xueer Jiamu.
You have won the support of House Mother Xueer Jiamu.  Quest complete: Patrons of the Library. Return to Ledger Keeper Shen to receive your reward.
Quest complete: Patrons of the Library. Return to Ledger Keeper Shen to receive your reward.

quests.title: Tell me about the House of Silk Lanterns.
quests.mission: Conversation with House Mother Xueer Jiamu
dialog: Welcome to the House of Silk Lanterns. Tea, music, warm silk and a quiet room - everything a tired traveller could wish for, and nobody here will ask your name. But hear me: the ladies of this house are my daughters in all but blood. Be gentle, pay what is fair, and a lantern will always be lit for you. Raise a hand to one of them, and Chu-long will show you the canal.

quests.title: Your hair
quests.mission: Conversation with House Mother Xueer Jiamu
dialog: Born with it. In my village they called it a curse. In Nanzhang they call it a fortune.

quests.title: The lamps
quests.mission: Conversation with House Mother Xueer Jiamu
dialog: Purple lamps in every room. The merchants say they come from the far West. I think they come from Hotan.

quests.title: Do you remember me?
quests.mission: Conversation with House Mother Xueer Jiamu
dialog: Welcome back. My ladies speak well of you - in this house that is worth more than gold. Be gentle, and the lanterns stay lit for you.

quests.title: An Evening at the House of Silk Lanterns
quests.mission: Spend an evening with one of the ladies of the house
quests.rewards: Evening buff: +3 STR, +3 INT for 1 hour
dialog: Once a day, a guest of this house may spend an evening with one of my ladies - Meixiang at the door, or Yuelan, Hongxia, Taohua, Lanxin or Huiling inside. Tea, music, a game of go, a good conversation... whatever you both enjoy. Choose one of them and tell her: "I would like to spend time with you." The house asks 6,900,000 gold for the evening - give it to her with [Accept], and she gives you your reward at once: a clear head and strength in your arms for an hour (+3 STR, +3 INT). That completes your task. One evening a day - the house opens again after midnight. Shall I tell my ladies to expect you?
Then go and choose. Only one lady per evening, mind - and treat her the way you would want your own sister treated.
Another time, then. The lanterns will still be lit.

You have not had your evening yet? Choose one of my ladies and ask her - she takes the 6,900,000 gold and gives you your reward at once. If you have already paid and received nothing, go to any of my ladies - you will not pay twice.
You have had your evening for today, dear guest. One a day - that is the rule of this house. Come back tomorrow, after midnight.

quests.title: Where does the trade road lead?
dialog: Up from this landing, past the hives and the stone giants, to Kuhe Village - then across the dry river and on to the old road that runs east to Nanzhang. Before the landing, caravans from Hotan went the long way around the ridge. Now they cross the water, rest in Kuhe and save two days. The road is new and wild, but every season more wheels roll on it.

quests.title: Do you remember me?
dialog: Every crate you dug out of those rocks reached Kuhe. The merchants call that stretch of the road by your name now.

quests.title: Crates Among the Rocks
dialog: One of my wagons to Kuhe was overturned on the slope. The Magma Cyclops came down and scattered my crates among the rocks - salt, cloth, tea, all of it. The driver got away; the crates did not, and the stone giants do not like visitors. A trade road lives on trust: every crate that arrives is one more reason for the merchants to take it again, and every crate lost is one more reason to go around.

quests.title: Crates Among the Rocks
dialog: My last wagon to Kuhe never arrived. The Magma Cyclops came down the slope, overturned it and scattered my crates among the rocks - salt, cloth, tea, all of it. The driver got away, thank the heavens. The crates did not. They are lying up there on the slope, right among those stone giants, and the giants do not like visitors. Bring back 40 of my crates. Every one you save is one more reason for the merchants to trust this road.
Thank you! The wagon went over on the slope along the road to Kuhe, south of the landing, where the Magma Cyclops roam. Most crates are smashed - about one in five is still whole.
I understand. Stone giants are not everyone's idea of a pleasant walk.
Not 40 yet. Every crate counts - the merchants in Kuhe are waiting for their salt.
Your pack is too full for what I have for you. Make some room and come back.

40 crates! A few dents, a little dust - the salt does not mind. They go to Kuhe with the next wagon, and this time with two guards. Take this. A merchant who forgets a favour soon has no road left to trade on.
You have the crates. Return to Hu Wanli on the square of Hive Ridge Landing.

quests.title: The Winter Pelt Contract
quests.mission: Conversation with Hunt Warden Shu Yan
dialog: The old houses of the Rich District - Han, Su and Wen - order their winter furs from the Hunter Union. Nothing but Mystic Frost Tiger will do, and only pelts without a trace of fire or poison. The Frost Tigers prowl outside the north gate. Last winter one of their Champions tore apart two of our hunters before it was brought down. The Union does not forget its dead.

quests.title: What does the Hunter Union do?
quests.mission: Conversation with Hunt Warden Shu Yan
dialog: We keep the roads honest and the beasts away from them. Traders carry goods between the cities, thieves try to take them, and hunters ride alongside to make sure the goods arrive. Join the Union and you are paid for every thief you stop. And when the old houses want pelts, horns or fangs, they come to us first - nobody knows the beasts around Nanzhang better.

quests.title: Do you remember me?
quests.mission: Conversation with Hunt Warden Shu Yan
dialog: Lord Han wears your pelts to the morning tea and tells everyone he hunted them himself. I let him. The Union knows the truth.

quests.title: Why is your Dragon Flag green?
quests.mission: Conversation with Hunt Warden Uchiha Shu Yan
dialog: Green? This is an Emerald Dragon Flag, traveler. Huang Long, the dragon that guards Nanzhang, is emerald-green. If you come from the north, you must have heard of the Gold Dragon Flag - the dragon of Jangan was golden. There are three cities, and each of them has its own flag, filled with the essence of its dragon: - Gold Dragon Flag - Jangan; - Emerald Dragon Flag - Nanzhang; - Sapphire Dragon Flag - Suzhou; And there is one more, the most powerful of all - the Three Dragons Flag. If you bring me two Gold Dragon Flags, I can help you get an Emerald Dragon Flag. Maybe even the Sapphire and the Three Dragons Flag, if you can face the trials.
Good. Bring me two Gold Dragon Flags. Keep them in your inventory, not on your back.
As you wish. If you change your mind, come back and ask me again.
Bring me two Gold Dragon Flags - in your inventory, not on your back. Then talk to me about the Dragon Flag.
Emerald, like Huang Long, the dragon that guards Nanzhang. You already know the rest of the story.

quests.title: How is the library coming along?
quests.mission: Conversation with Hunt Warden Uchiha Shu Yan
dialog: My tanners are curing hides for the bindings, and I have started a new bestiary for the first shelf. It begins with Hu Lan.

quests.title: The Library of Nanzhang
dialog: The old library? The Hunter Union kept its bestiaries there - every claw, fang and trail of these lands, drawn by hand. They burned with the rest. Ledger Keeper Shen guards whatever was saved.

Rebuild the library? Then the Hunter Union will give its best hides and its tanners for the bindings - on one condition: a shelf for new bestiaries. My hunters will fill it. Tell Lady Shen the Uchiha keep their word.
You have won the support of Hunt Warden Uchiha Shu Yan.
You have won the support of Hunt Warden Uchiha Shu Yan.  Quest complete: Patrons of the Library. Return to Ledger Keeper Shen to receive your reward.
Quest complete: Patrons of the Library. Return to Ledger Keeper Shen to receive your reward.

quests.title: Tell me about the Uchiha clan.
quests.mission: Conversation with Hunt Warden Uchiha Shu Yan
dialog: The Uchiha are one of the oldest clans of Nanzhang. For as long as these walls have stood, we have defended the city and the merchants who keep it alive. We have been proud hunters for generations - the fan on our banner is older than the dragon gate. Ride with us as a hunter and share the bounty. Or, if you trade, hire our blades as a trader - for a fair fee, no caravan is safer.

quests.title: Dragon Flag
quests.mission: Bring 2 Gold Dragon Flags to Hunt Warden Uchiha Shu Yan (in your inventory)
quests.rewards: Experience 74493031 / SP 5000 / Pure Dragon Flag x1
dialog: This flag on my back is not a Gold Dragon Flag, traveler - it is an Emerald Dragon Flag. Huang Long, the dragon that guards Nanzhang, is emerald-green. If you come from the north, you must have heard of the Gold Dragon Flag - the dragon of Jangan was golden. There are three cities, and each of them has its own flag, filled with the essence of its dragon: - Gold Dragon Flag - Jangan; - Emerald Dragon Flag - Nanzhang; - Sapphire Dragon Flag - Suzhou; And there is one more, the most powerful of all - the Three Dragons Flag. If you bring me two Gold Dragon Flags, I can help you get an Emerald Dragon Flag. Maybe even the Sapphire and the Three Dragons Flag, if you can face the trials.
Good. Bring me two Gold Dragon Flags. Keep them in your inventory, not on your back.
As you wish. If you change your mind, come back and ask me again.
You do not have two Gold Dragon Flags in your inventory. Come back when you have them.
Make some room in your inventory and talk to me again.
Have you brought me two Gold Dragon Flags? Give them to me and I will purify them.
I cannot do this right now. Come back a little later.
It is done. I have cleansed your two Gold Dragon Flags of the golden dragon's essence. Here is your Pure Dragon Flag.

quests.title: The Pure Dragon Flag
quests.mission: Take the Pure Dragon Flag to Shamaness Yue
dialog: I have cleansed your two Gold Dragon Flags of the golden dragon's essence. Now they are one pure flag, like a vessel waiting for water. You must not taint it, and you must not even wear it, so that no other essence can soak into it. We prepared it to be filled with the essence of Huang Long. Take the flag to Shamaness Yue - she will tell you what to do next.
Shamaness Yue lives here in Nanzhang. Go to her and show her the Pure Dragon Flag.
The flag can wait. Come back when you are ready.
Take the Pure Dragon Flag to Shamaness Yue in Nanzhang.
So this is the Pure Dragon Flag that Shu Yan prepared. Not a trace of the golden dragon left in it. Good - we can begin.
Take the Pure Dragon Flag to Shamaness Yue in Nanzhang.

quests.title: A Smuggler's Help
quests.mission: Ask Merchant Yee-Wish (Nanzhang or Hotan) about the Sapphire Dragon Flag
dialog: I see you got the Emerald Dragon Flag. Congratulations. If you want the Three Dragons Flag, you also need a Sapphire Dragon Flag. That flag is very rare here. These days it is rare even in Suzhou itself. But there is one person who can help you. A smuggler on the black market - talk to Merchant Yee-Wish. He travels to Suzhou from time to time, he should be able to help you.
You will find Merchant Yee-Wish at his camp - in Nanzhang or in Hotan.
The Sapphire Dragon Flag will not find you by itself. Come back when you are ready.
Talk to Merchant Yee-Wish - in Nanzhang or in Hotan.
A Sapphire Dragon Flag? Yes, I can help you get one... but it will cost you.
Talk to Merchant Yee-Wish - in Nanzhang or in Hotan.

quests.title: Three Dragons Flag
quests.mission: Bring the Emerald Dragon Flag, the Sapphire Dragon Flag and a Gold Dragon Flag (in your inventory) to Hunt Warden Uchiha Shu Yan
quests.rewards: Experience 49662021 / SP 4000 / Three Dragons Flag (Str +6, Int +6)
dialog: Congratulations on getting the Sapphire Dragon Flag. You are one of the few who have come this far. If you give me the Emerald Dragon Flag, the Sapphire Dragon Flag and a Gold Dragon Flag, I can turn them into the Three Dragons Flag for you. It is a secret technique of our clan. You have come so far - I will do it for you for free.
Bring all three flags in your inventory and talk to me.
Think it over. The Three Dragons Flag is worth it.
I need all three: the Emerald Dragon Flag, the Sapphire Dragon Flag and a Gold Dragon Flag - in your inventory, not on your back.
Make some room in your inventory and talk to me again.
Do you have the Emerald Dragon Flag, the Sapphire Dragon Flag and a Gold Dragon Flag with you?
I cannot do this right now. Come back a little later.
The Three Dragons Flag is yours. Congratulations! It can be made even stronger - for that, talk to Huntress Uchiha Konan-Ka Ryu.

quests.title: The Winter Pelt Contract
quests.mission: Collect 60 Prime Frost Tiger Pelts; Slay 1 Mystic Frost Tiger Champion
dialog: The old houses of the Rich District have ordered their winter furs from the Hunter Union - Han, Su and Wen, every one of them. Nothing but Mystic Frost Tiger will do, and only pelts without a trace of fire or poison. The Frost Tigers prowl outside the north gate. Bring me sixty clean pelts. And one more thing: a Frost Tiger Champion tore apart two of our hunters last week. Bring it down. The Union does not forget its dead.
Good. Skin them carefully - about one tiger in four gives a pelt fit for a lord's shoulders. The Champion is bigger than the rest and never hunts far from the gate.
Then I will tell the lords the frost came early. They will not like it.
Sixty clean pelts and the Champion's hide. The houses are already asking.
Your pack is full. Make some room before you collect your pay.
Sixty pelts without a single burn mark, and the beast that killed our brothers is dead. The Union will drink to you tonight. Here is your share of the contract. You hunt like one of us.
The contract is filled. Return to Hunt Warden Uchiha Shu Yan at the Uchiha pagoda in the Trade District.

quests.title: Never Camp Near a Hive
dialog: When I was a boy the Ongs were small - they left you alone if you left their hives alone. Since the mountain woke they are as big as a dog, they hunt in swarms and they come for blood, not honey. One spring the swarms came down to the edge of the fields and took two goats and old Tian Shou's dog. That is the first rule I teach anyone who walks the ridge with me: never camp near a hive.

quests.title: What happened to the animals?
dialog: Most of them died in the first year - the deer, the foxes, the hill goats, even the birds. The ash got into their lungs and the water turned bitter. The few that survived did not stay the same. Whatever came out of the mountain got into them too.

quests.title: What are those huge wasps?
dialog: Ongs - Bloodwings and Dreadwings. They always nested in this valley, but they were small and left you alone if you left their hives alone. Now they are as big as a dog, they hunt in swarms and they come for blood, not for honey. Never make camp near a hive.

quests.title: What are the giants on the slopes?
dialog: Those were lizards once - small one-eyed lizards that slept on hot rocks. The fire of the mountain changed them. They grew into golems of stone and magma, taller than a house, and they learned to think. Travellers call them Magma Cyclops. They wait, they watch, and they remember where you walked.

quests.title: Do you remember me?
dialog: The ridge is quieter since you hunted with me. Keep your voice down anyway - the mountain still listens.

quests.title: Never Camp Near a Hive
dialog: Keep your voice down. Hear that hum from the ridge? When I was a boy the Ongs were small - they left you alone if you left their hives alone. Now they are as big as a dog, they hunt in swarms and they come for blood, not honey. This spring the swarms came down to the edge of the fields. Two goats last week, and old Tian Shou's dog. Next time it will be one of us. Thin them out before they nest any closer: 150 Bloodwings and 150 Dreadwings. Will you hunt with me?
Good. The hives hang on the ridge above the village, a short climb from the caravan cart. Kill fast, keep moving, and never let the swarm close around you.
Then I hunt alone, as always. Keep away from the ridge after dark.
I can still hear them from the fields. 150 Bloodwings and 150 Dreadwings - we are not there yet.
Your pack is full, hunter. Make some room before I hand you your reward.

Listen... quiet. For the first time this season I hear the wind on the ridge and not the hum. The fields are safe for a while. Take this. A hunter pays his debts the same day - tomorrow the mountain may have other plans.
The swarms are thinner. Return to Hunter Shi Lang by the caravan cart in Kuhe Village.

quests.title: Jade in the Roots
quests.mission: Conversation with Jade Collector Lady Bai Lan
dialog: The walking trees south of the city stand on an old jade quarry. A hundred years ago the miners fled, and the Ancient and Elder Yeoha grew over the pits. Their roots still hold the stones nobody dug out - raw jade, wrapped in wood like a pearl in its shell. I buy them raw and do the cutting myself. Nobody else in Nanzhang has the patience.

quests.title: How do you tell good jade?
quests.mission: Conversation with Jade Collector Lady Bai Lan
dialog: Not by the colour, as fools think. Hold it to the light: good jade glows from inside like still water. Tap it and it sings instead of clicking. And it stays cool in the hand on the hottest day. My oldest piece is older than this city - and far better behaved.

quests.title: Do you remember me?
quests.mission: Conversation with Jade Collector Lady Bai Lan
dialog: This pendant? Cut from one of your root stones - green as spring and cold as the river. Every guest asks about it.

quests.title: Jade in the Roots
dialog: Do you know what the walking trees south of the city stand on? An old jade quarry. A hundred years ago the miners fled, and the Ancient and Elder Yeoha grew over the pits. Their roots still hold the stones nobody dug out - raw jade, wrapped in wood like a pearl in its shell. Bring me forty nuggets. Raw, mind you - no polishing, no cutting. The cutting I do myself.
The Yeoha walk among the old pits south of Nanzhang, a short ride beyond the gate. Perhaps one tree in five still clutches a stone worth my time.
Then the trees keep their jade. They have kept it for a century already.
Forty stones, traveller. Raw, green and whole - I can tell a chipped one from across the square.
Your pack is full. Make some room - jade deserves a little space.

Look at this one - green as spring and cold as the river. A hundred years in the roots and not a single crack. You have an eye after all. Take this, and come show me anything else that glows from inside.
You have the jade. Return to Jade Collector Lady Bai Lan by the statue in the Rich District.

quests.title: How is the library coming along?
quests.mission: Conversation with Jade Cutter Yin Zhao
dialog: The jade locks are already taking shape on my bench. When the library opens, the first book I read will be the oldest one on stones.

quests.title: The Library of Nanzhang
dialog: The old library by the Lotus Garden? It burned long before I opened this shop. They say every book on gems and jade in the Empire stood on its shelves. Ledger Keeper Shen still guards what is left - ask her, if you love old pages.
A library for Nanzhang? Tell Lady Shen she has my word. I will make jade locks for every cabinet - the books on stones are older than my hands, and it is time I paid them back.
I have already given my word - jade locks for every cabinet. Go and tell Lady Shen.

quests.title: The Library of Nanzhang
dialog: The old library by the Lotus Garden? It burned long before I opened this shop. They say every book on gems and jade in the Empire stood on its shelves. Ledger Keeper Shen still guards what is left - ask her, if you love old pages.
A library for Nanzhang? Tell Lady Shen she has my word. I will make jade locks for every cabinet - the books on stones are older than my hands, and it is time I paid them back.
You have won the support of Jade Cutter Yin Zhao.
You have won the support of Jade Cutter Yin Zhao.  Quest complete: Patrons of the Library. Return to Ledger Keeper Shen to receive your reward.
Quest complete: Patrons of the Library. Return to Ledger Keeper Shen to receive your reward.

quests.title: The Library of Nanzhang
dialog: A library? Darling, I read gowns, not books. But I remember the smoke over the Lotus Garden - it ruined a whole bolt of white silk I had drying on the roof.
Money for books? Oh, sweetheart, look at this train - three evenings of sewing and a fortune in thread. Every coin I have, I am already wearing. Tell Lady Shen I wish her luck, and a good tailor.

quests.title: A Gown the Colour of Night
dialog: Half the gowns in this district are mine, and the other half are copies of mine. For the lantern festival I wanted a colour nobody could copy - so I dyed my silk with the scales of the Nightfang Guivres that hunt after dark south of the city. Ground fine, they give a blue as deep as the sky an hour before dawn, and it never fades.

quests.title: Fashion
dialog: Bare shoulders and a high slit - in Hotan they would faint. In Nanzhang they pay double.

quests.title: Rashid
dialog: He smells of cinnamon and talks of pepper. A charming man, in small doses.

quests.title: Do you remember me?
dialog: Every lady at the lantern festival asked where that blue came from. I told them: from the night itself. And from you - but that part is our secret.

quests.title: A Gown the Colour of Night
dialog: Half the gowns in this district are mine, and the other half are copies of mine. For the lantern festival I want a colour nobody can copy. The Nightfang Guivres hunt after dark, south of the city. Their scales hold a blue as deep as the sky an hour before dawn. Ground fine and mixed into the dye, it never fades. Bring me fifty scales, darling. The copyists will weep.
Wonderful. Look for them beyond the south gate - they come out when the lanterns are lit. Take only clean scales; about one guivre in four will have one worth keeping.
Pity. Then I shall wear last year's blue, and everyone will notice.
Fifty scales, darling. A gown is not a handkerchief.
Your bags are overflowing. Make some room first, or my thanks will not fit.

Oh, look at that blue... It drinks the lantern light. At the festival every lady in the district will want this gown, and only one will have it. Take this, with my thanks - and keep the secret of the colour to yourself.
You have the scales. Return to Lady Nazira in the Night District of Nanzhang.

quests.title: Tell me about your house.
dialog: My great-grandfather built it when his first caravan came back from the west with forty bales of silk and not one missing. Cedar beams, glazed roof tiles, a courtyard where the rain falls into a stone basin. Every generation added a room. I added the garden - and a lock on the wine cellar.

quests.title: Do you write poetry?
dialog: Every evening, by lamplight. Shall I read you one? 'The lanterns of Nanzhang burn low; even the moon walks slowly past the rich men's gates.' My father calls it impertinent. That is how I know it is good.

quests.title: Feng Ling asked about you
dialog: Feng Ling? The ticket seller from the Golden Dragon... why do you ask?

Feng Ling... the ticket seller from the Golden Dragon? She asked about me? I... yes. Tell her yes. I have liked her for a long time - every time I walked past the casino, I hoped she would look up. Now go to Aurelius and tell him the debt is gone, before I start blushing in front of you.
Goal complete: Tell Ledger Keeper Shen what Feng Ling asked.
Goal complete: Tell Ledger Keeper Shen what Feng Ling asked.  Quest complete: The Investor Who Stepped Back. Return to Ledger Keeper Shen to receive your reward.
Quest complete: The Investor Who Stepped Back. Return to Ledger Keeper Shen to receive your reward.

quests.title: What happened to the old library?
dialog: My parents kept it - the Library of Nanzhang, by the Lotus Garden. Scholars came from Jangan and even from the West to read there. One winter evening a lamp fell, the fire ran through the scrolls, and my parents went back inside to save what they could. They never came out. I was small then. Now there is only an empty square and a monument where it stood. The books that survived lie in the pavilion nearby.

quests.title: Why do you keep the burnt books?
dialog: Because they are all that is left of my parents' work. Some pages are half gone, some books are only covers. By day I keep the caravan ledgers for the guild hall; in the evenings I sit in the pavilion and copy whatever can still be read into clean books. A city that forgets what it once wrote down slowly forgets itself. I will not let Nanzhang forget.

quests.title: The new library
dialog: The new library - thank you, friend. Because of you the work will begin very soon. My parents would have liked you.

quests.title: A Petition to the Throne
quests.mission: Deliver the Petition for an Audience to Palace Steward Bai Yun
dialog: My parents kept the Library of Nanzhang. It burned when I was small, and they burned with it. Where it stood there is only an empty square and a monument now; the books that survived lie in the pavilion nearby, and I look after them. I have asked the Emperor to rebuild it more than once. Every time the answer was the same: no funds. I want to try again. Will you carry my petition for an audience to Palace Steward Bai Yun?
Thank you. Bai Yun keeps the west terrace of the Imperial Palace, by the white steps. Give him the petition yourself - letters sent by messenger end up at the bottom of the pile.
I understand. I have waited for years - I can wait a little longer.
Have you seen Bai Yun yet? He is at the palace, by the west terrace.

A petition from Lady Shen. Again. I know her hand - I have read it many times. Very well: I will put her name before the council for an audience. But tell her plainly - this is the last time. The court has heard 'no funds' too often to listen to the word 'library' again.

He agreed? Then I will have my audience... and he is right, it will be my last chance. This time I will not go with empty hands. Thank you - take this for your trouble. Come back to me soon; there is much to prepare.
Your pack is full - I cannot hand you the petition. Make some room and come back.

A petition from Lady Shen. Again. I know her hand - I have read it many times. Very well: I will put her name before the council for an audience. But tell her plainly - this is the last time. The court has heard 'no funds' too often to listen to the word 'library' again.

quests.title: Patrons of the Library
quests.mission: Win the support of Jade Cutter Yin Zhao; Win the support of House Mother Xueer Jiamu; Win the support of Bank Manager Jin Bao; Win the support of Provisioner Gu Wan; Win the support of Hunt Warden Uchiha Shu Yan; Win the support of Hotel Host Wang Fu; Win the support of Madam Shangguan Yu Rong; Win the support of Bathmaster Aurelius
dialog: The audience is set, and this time I must not come with empty hands. I have begun gathering materials and people willing to work - but the court will only listen if the richest people of Nanzhang stand behind me. Will you speak with them on my behalf? Some will say yes, some will not. I need patrons, not promises.

Thank you! Ask each of them about the Library of Nanzhang: Jade Cutter Yin Zhao at her workshop; Bank Manager Jin Bao, Guild Registrar Cui Fang and Provisioner Gu Wan by the bank; Caravan Master Bao Long and Hunt Warden Uchiha Shu Yan in the Trade District; Bathmaster Aurelius and Bath Hostess Hanae at the baths, and Hotel Host Wang Fu next door; House Mother Xueer Jiamu and Lady Nazira in the Night District; and Madam Shangguan Yu Rong by the pond in Lantern Row.
Then I will knock on their doors myself. It will just take... a few years longer.
Not every patron on your list has given their word yet. I will wait - every one of them counts.
Your pack is too full for what I have for you. Make some room and come back.

Eight patrons? Eight! Jade from Yin Zhao, the seal of the bank, the coin of the baths, Gu Wan's stores, hides from the hunters, rooms for the builders, Madam Shangguan's caravans - and the House of Silk Lanterns paying for the walls... I never dared to hope for half of that. Thank you. Take this - and come back to me soon. A library needs more than money; it needs materials.

quests.title: The Cancelled Audience
quests.mission: Deliver the Ledger of Patrons and Goods to Palace Steward Bai Yun
dialog: Bad news. The palace has cancelled my audience - no reason given, just a seal and a date crossed out. But we have come too far to stop now. I have written down everything we have gathered: every patron, every hide, every bone and lump of resin. Take this ledger to Bai Yun. If the court will not see me, let it at least see what Nanzhang has already given.
Thank you. Bai Yun is at the west terrace of the palace, as before. Put the ledger into his own hands.
I understand... Perhaps tomorrow I will find the courage to go myself.
Have you seen Bai Yun yet? The ledger must reach him before the council meets.

Lady Shen's ledger... Patrons from the bank to the Night District, materials already gathered, craftsmen sworn. This changes things. The audience was cancelled because the court expected another empty petition. In the light of this, I would say her chances are good. Tell her that - from me.
He said that? 'Her chances are good'? Then we wait for the audience - and this time I will not lose heart. Thank you, my friend. Take this. Whatever the court decides, we did everything right.
Your pack is full - the ledger will not fit. Make some room and come back.

Lady Shen's ledger... Patrons from the bank to the Night District, materials already gathered, craftsmen sworn. This changes things. The audience was cancelled because the court expected another empty petition. In the light of this, I would say her chances are good. Tell her that - from me.

quests.title: The Investor Who Stepped Back
quests.mission: Find out why Bathmaster Aurelius stepped back; Ask Casino Ticket Seller Feng Ling about the debt of Aurelius; Tell Ledger Keeper Shen what Feng Ling asked; Tell Bathmaster Aurelius that his debt is forgiven
dialog: Just as we were waiting for the audience - one of our patrons has withdrawn. Aurelius. Without the money of the baths the walls will never be finished, and the court knows it. He agreed after Hanae talked to him, and now he sends word that he cannot. Something is wrong; that is not like him. Will you go to the baths and find out what happened?
Thank you. Be gentle with him - Aurelius is proud, and proud men do not like to admit trouble.
Then I will have to find another patron... though I do not know where.
Is Aurelius with us again? Not yet, I see. Follow the trail - I will wait here for news.
Your pack is too full for what I have for you. Make some room and come back.

He is giving it to the library after all... and Feng Ling... Forgive me, I am smiling like a fool. Thank you. You saved our patron, and perhaps something more. Take this - and come back to me soon. The court may call at any moment.

Lady Shen sent you... I am ashamed, friend. The truth? I owe the Golden Dragon Casino. I had never played in my life - then came my birthday, my friends took me to the casino, the wine kept flowing and the dice kept rolling... I lost a great deal of money. Until that debt is paid, I cannot give a single coin to anyone. I am sorry.

The debt of Aurelius? Oh, I remember that birthday... I am Feng Ling; my father owns the Golden Dragon. I will talk to him - I want a library in this city too. Will it work? Between us: I run the casino now. Father is not as strong as he was. Consider the debt forgiven. But... you know Lady Shen? I have admired her for a long time. Would you ask her if she would agree to meet me?

Feng Ling... the ticket seller from the Golden Dragon? She asked about me? I... yes. Tell her yes. I have liked her for a long time - every time I walked past the casino, I hoped she would look up. Now go to Aurelius and tell him the debt is gone, before I start blushing in front of you.

Forgiven? The whole debt? I thought that money was lost for good... Then let it go where I promised it would. The baths will support the library - every coin I thought I had lost. Tell Lady Shen that Aurelius keeps his word.
You should first speak with Bathmaster Aurelius at the Nanzhang Baths.
Casino Ticket Seller Feng Ling at the Golden Dragon Casino in the Night District is the one to see about the debt.
Ledger Keeper Shen by the Lotus Garden should hear what Feng Ling asked.
Bathmaster Aurelius at the Nanzhang Baths should hear that his debt is forgiven.
Return to Ledger Keeper Shen by the Lotus Garden.

quests.title: The Emperor's Answer
quests.mission: Hear the Emperor's answer from Ledger Keeper Shen
dialog: There you are! Listen - while you were talking with Aurelius, I was at the audience. They called me at dawn, and I took a risk: I told the Emperor that I already had all the patrons and all the materials. And he said yes! The Emperor has agreed to rebuild the library! The work will begin very soon... Please, let me thank you properly.
Not now? Then come back soon - I am bursting with the news, and you are the first one I wanted to tell!
Your pack is too full for what I have for you. Make some room and come back.

From the fire to this day... my parents would have been so proud. Without you I would still be standing in front of the palace with a petition nobody reads. Take this, with all my gratitude. Whenever you pass the Lotus Garden, come and ask me about the new library.

quests.title: Hides for the Bindings
dialog: Every patron you found has kept their word. Madam Shangguan's caravans are already bringing silk and paper - but the old bindings are crumbling in the pavilion, and silk alone will not hold a spine. It needs leather. The best comes from the Mystic Tigers just outside the walls - thick, supple, and it does not crack in the cold. Bring me eighty hides, please. I will sort them myself.
Thank you. The Mystic Tigers prowl all around the walls, big and small. Only about one hide in four will be whole enough for a binding.
I understand. The books have waited this long; they can wait a little more - though not forever.
Eighty hides. I counted every book in the pavilion twice.
Your pack is full. Make some room and come back.

Eighty hides, and good ones. Hunt Warden Shu Yan's tanners will start on the spines tomorrow - silk outside, tiger leather inside. Thank you. The oldest books will finally stop falling apart in my hands.
You have the hides. Return to Ledger Keeper Shen by the Lotus Garden.

quests.title: Bone Glue and Ink
quests.mission: Collect 50 Blood Tiger Bones for Glue; Collect 50 Shadow Hydra Ink Sacs
dialog: The spines need glue, and the burnt pages must be copied anew. The old binders boiled their glue from the bones of Mystic Blood Tigers - nothing holds better. And the blackest ink in the Empire comes from the ink sacs of the Shadow Hydras in the marshes south of the city. Bring me fifty bones and fifty ink sacs. Then I can start copying what the fire left half-written.
The Blood Tigers hunt west of the city; the Shadow Hydras lurk in the marshes beyond the south gate. About one beast in four will give you what we need.
Then I will keep copying with watered ink. The pages will fade, but I will try.
Fifty bones and fifty ink sacs - one for the glue pot, one for the inkwell.
Your pack is full. Make some room and come back.
Good bones - the glue will hold for centuries. And this ink! Black as a moonless sky - words written with it will outlive the paper. Thank you. Every copied page is a page the fire did not win.
You have the bones and the ink sacs. Return to Ledger Keeper Shen by the Lotus Garden.

quests.title: Lacquer for the Shelves
dialog: Yin Zhao is cutting jade locks for the cabinets and Madam Shangguan has drawn the garden around the new walls - but the wood of the shelves will rot in our damp summers unless it is sealed. The best lacquer is made from the resin of the walking trees south of the city, the Ancient and Elder Yeoha. It hardens like amber and keeps the damp out for a hundred years. Bring me sixty lumps of resin.
The Yeoha walk among the old pits south of the city. Strike carefully - about one tree in four will bleed resin clean enough to use.
Then I will pray for dry summers. Nanzhang does not get many.
Sixty lumps of resin. A shelf for every book, and every shelf sealed.
Your pack is full. Make some room and come back.
Smell that - pine, honey and something older. The carpenters will lacquer the first shelves this week. Thank you. The books will have a dry home for a hundred years.
You have the resin. Return to Ledger Keeper Shen by the Lotus Garden.

quests.title: Where Is Mom?
dialog: When Hu Lan came, Mom said: hide in the well, Ah Fu, and don't come out until I call you. So we hid, me and my kitten. It was dark and cold, and then it was very quiet. Mom never called. But the lady with the drums knows my name now. She says Mom is looking for me too, and that she will show her the way. So we wait here, by the well, where Mom can see us.

quests.title: Why can't you leave the well?
dialog: Because Mom told me to wait here. If I go somewhere else, she won't find me. That's the rule: if you get lost, stay where you are. My kitten could go - she's braver than me. But she won't leave without me. At night the tigers walk past the well, but they don't see us anymore. Only you see us. That's strange, isn't it?

quests.title: Do you remember me?
dialog: The lady with the drums said Mom is looking for me too... She just has to find the way. I will wait here. Thank you for asking her!

quests.title: Where Is Mom?
quests.mission: Tell Shamaness Yue in Nanzhang the name of Ah Fu
dialog: When Hu Lan came, Mom said: hide in the well, Ah Fu, and don't come out until I call you. So we hid, me and my kitten. It was dark and cold, and then it was very quiet. Mom never called. We are out of the well now, but I can't see her anywhere. Maybe she is looking in the wrong place? My kitten says there is a lady in the big city who talks to people like us. Can you tell her my name? Ah Fu. Then maybe Mom can find the way to the well.
Thank you! The big city is Nanzhang. The lady sits up on a big stone, with drums and smoke. Say it right - Ah Fu. Mom always said it like a song.
Oh... that's okay. We will wait here. We are good at waiting.
Did you find the lady with the drums? She is in Nanzhang. Please tell her my name - Ah Fu.

Ah Fu... a little boy and a kitten, by the well on the old road. For years I have heard a mother calling that name in the smoke, and I never knew where to send her. Tonight I will burn the incense and beat the drum, and I will tell her: the well under the old roof - he is waiting there. Go in peace, traveler, and take this. You carried a name further than most people carry gold.
Did you tell her yet? The lady with the drums, in Nanzhang. My kitten keeps looking at the road.

quests.title: Tell me about the manor nearby.
dialog: The house on the hill is Dugu Manor. I raised it when the caravan roads had made my name known from Jangan to the western deserts. The halls were full of voices - my wife, my children, the cooks and the grooms - and in the stables stood a great brown behemoth that could carry a whole caravan's load. Hu Lan's beasts took all of it in one night. The walls stood; the people did not. Their names are carved on the great tomb in the valley below.

quests.title: Who are you?
dialog: Once, a name spoken with respect on every caravan road of this land: Dugu Jing. I hunted the thieves who preyed on merchants, then led the caravans myself, and in the end I was richer than the men who hired me. I built the house on the hill and brought my wife, my children and my servants here from Nanzhang. When Hu Lan's beasts came out of the trees, I held the courtyard so that my wife could run. She fled into the dark with a maid named Ah Yun. Now I know where she rests.

quests.title: Peace for Dugu Jing
dialog: I cannot touch the living. My hands passed through my own children when I tried to close their eyes. I could still dig graves - the earth does not mind a ghost - so I buried every one of them, and I mended every roof tile of this house, though no one will ever sleep in it again. Always hungry, always thirsty, always alone. As long as Hu Lan walked, I could not rest.

quests.title: What do you see in the water?
dialog: (He does not turn his head.) The house as it was. Lanterns in every window, smoke rising from the kitchen, my children chasing the geese along the bank while their mother pretended to scold them. The water remembers it better than I do. Some nights the lilies close, the surface goes still, and for a moment the lights come back. Then a fish breaks the mirror, and it is only a pond again.

quests.title: Why do the tigers leave you alone?
dialog: They remember me. Hu Lan's beasts tore this house apart, and they still prowl the hill as if it belonged to them. But not one of them comes near the water while I stand here. I think they can smell what I am - something their master already killed once, and that did not stay dead. Do not take comfort in it, traveler. They walk around me. They will not walk around you.

quests.title: Do you ever leave this place?
dialog: Leave? Every road I ever rode begins and ends at that gate. My caravans are dust, my men lie under the stones in the valley, and the house would belong to the beasts again the moment I turned my back on it. Some nights I walk as far as the old road and watch the lights of Nanzhang on the horizon. I never go further. The dead have no business in a city of the living.

quests.title: Do you remember me?
dialog: Traveler. You carried my words to the living once. The dead remember such debts longer than anyone.

quests.title: Who are you?
quests.mission: Talk to Deng Ruoxi on Lantern Row in Nanzhang
dialog: Who am I? Once, a name spoken with respect on every caravan road of this land. Dugu Jing. I hunted the thieves who preyed on merchants. Then I led the caravans myself, and in the end I was richer than the men who hired me. I built the house on the hill and brought my wife, my children and my servants here from Nanzhang. Then Hu Lan's beasts came out of the trees. I tried to reach my wife, and I held the courtyard so that she could run. She fled into the dark with one of our maids - they saw me fall, and then I saw nothing more. Find her for me, traveler. If she lived, someone in Nanzhang will know.
The maid's name was Ah Yun. They say her daughter lights the lanterns of Lantern Row in Nanzhang now. Ask her what became of my wife, Lady Qiu Lan.
Then leave me to the water. I will be here. I am always here.
Nanzhang. Lantern Row. The lamplighter. Go, and come back with the truth.

Who am I? Deng Ruoxi - I light the lanterns of this row. My mother was Ah Yun, a maid in the house of Lord Dugu when she was young. So he sent you... Then he is still waiting by his pond. The night Hu Lan's beasts came, my mother saw the lord fall defending my father at the stable gate - a blade went right through him, and then a tiger took him by the throat. She ran, and Lady Qiu Lan ran with her. They came to Nanzhang with nothing and lived with us here, in this house behind me. The lady died a year later - peacefully, in her sleep. We buried her in the Nanzhang cemetery, under the old trees.
Go to Deng Ruoxi, the lamplighter of Lantern Row in Nanzhang.

quests.title: Tell me about the manor nearby.
quests.mission: Read the tablet on the Dugu family tomb
dialog: The house on the hill is Dugu Manor. I raised it when the caravan roads had made my name known from Jangan to the western deserts. The halls were full of voices - my wife, my children, the cooks and the grooms. In the stables stood a great brown behemoth that could carry a whole caravan's load on its back. Hu Lan's beasts took all of it in one night. The walls stood; the people did not. Since then I have mended every stone of that house, though no one will ever live in it again. The names of the dead are carved on the great tomb in the valley below the hill. Go and read them. I cannot.
The great tomb stands in the valley below the hill, among the graves I dug myself. The tablet on its front bears my name.
As you wish. The stones will wait. Stones are good at waiting.
The tomb is in the valley below the hill. Read the tablet.

HERE REST THE HOUSE OF DUGU AND ALL WHO SERVED IT. LORD DUGU JING - HUNTER OF THIEVES, MASTER OF CARAVANS, MERCHANT OF NANZHANG. HE KEPT THE ROADS SAFE FOR OTHERS. (Below, in fresher letters:) HE COULD NOT KEEP HIS OWN HOUSE. The stone is clean and the grass around the graves is cut short. Someone tends this place every night.
Read the tablet on the great tomb of the Dugu family, in the valley below the manor.

quests.title: Peace for Dugu Jing
dialog: I cannot touch the living. My hands passed through my own children when I tried to close their eyes. I could still dig graves - the earth does not mind a ghost - so I buried every one of them, and I mended every roof tile of this house, though no one will ever sleep in it again. I am always hungry. Always thirsty. Always alone. I long for a real life, or for a real death, and I am given neither. As long as Hu Lan walks, I cannot rest. Kill him. Bring me that peace, and what is left of the Dugu fortune is yours.
He wanders the wild lands around Nanzhang and appears when he pleases. Gather strong companions - he will not fall to a single blade.
No one could blame you. Even I could not stand against him.
He still walks. I can feel it, like cold water in my chest.
Your pack is too full for what I would give you. Make room and come back to me.

(The red embers of his eyes grow dim.) It is over. For the first time in all these centuries, I feel... tired. It is a good feeling. Take the gold of my caravans, and what a man who fought on every road of this land can still teach. When the mist lifts from this hill, look for me by my wife's side. Thank you, traveler.
Hu Lan has fallen. Return to Lord Dugu Jing at the pond below Dugu Manor.

quests.title: Who built this square?
dialog: The old families of Nanzhang, together. My grandfather paid for the stone ring around the statue, the Su family for the trees, the silk merchants for the paths. They argued for three years about the colour of the stones. In the end everyone was offended, so everyone was satisfied.

quests.title: Why do you wear armour in the city?
dialog: Because my family has worn it for six generations, and because it is the only thing in my house that has never been in debt. The Han guarded the river gate when this city was a ring of wooden walls. Now we guard our good name - it is heavier, and it needs more polishing.

quests.title: How is the library coming along?
quests.mission: Conversation with Madam Shangguan Yu Rong
dialog: My husband's drawings are spread on Lady Shen's table. When the first pavilion stands, I will plant a plum tree beside it - he loved plum blossoms.

quests.title: The Library of Nanzhang
dialog: The library... my husband drew a new one, you know. Every column, every window, reading pavilions around a pond like this one. He never found anyone to pay for it. Since he died, the drawings sleep in a chest in my house.

Lady Shen wants to rebuild it? Then let her have my husband's drawings - he designed that library for twenty years and never saw a single stone laid. My caravans will bring the timber, the silk and the paper, and my ledgers will make sure the court never finds a missing coin. The garden I will design myself. Tell her yes - for him.
You have won the support of Madam Shangguan Yu Rong.
You have won the support of Madam Shangguan Yu Rong.  Quest complete: Patrons of the Library. Return to Ledger Keeper Shen to receive your reward.
Quest complete: Patrons of the Library. Return to Ledger Keeper Shen to receive your reward.

quests.title: Who are you, Madam?
quests.mission: Conversation with Madam Shangguan Yu Rong
dialog: Half of what moves through this city passes through my ledgers. My caravans carry silk, salt and tea between the shops of Nanzhang and the roads beyond, and my gardeners plant what I draw. My husband was an architect. Nanzhang stood here long before he was born - but when the horde of Hu Lan came, most of the city burned and was destroyed. At the last moment a dragon saved us, and it guards Nanzhang to this day. The city was rebuilt on my husband's designs - the gates, the bridges and the bank you walk past every day. He did not build them, he drew them; the masons did the rest. Most of what you see stands on his drawings. He drew the lines, I counted the coins. Now I do both. Some call my bookkeeping creative. I call it keeping a widow's fortune in one piece.

quests.title: What does a magistrate do here?
dialog: I keep the county records, settle quarrels between merchants and see that the edicts of the court are read aloud in every quarter. The stele behind me holds the newest of them. Since Hu Lan's horde burned half of Nanzhang, there has been far more rebuilding than judging. If you want honest work, the Hunt Warden and the city guards can always use capable hands.

quests.title: Stone That Has Seen Fire
dialog: Every time Chiyan shakes, ordinary stone cracks like a dry biscuit. But stone that has been through the fire does not crack. The Magma Cyclops on the slopes are made of it - they were lizards once, and the mountain baked them into living rock. That is why the wall on the mountain side is built of fire-stone, block by block. When the mountain shakes again, it will be the last thing standing in Kuhe.

quests.title: What are you building?
dialog: First the roofs - the ash broke half of them in the eruption. Then a stable and a covered yard for the caravans, and a new wall on the mountain side. When I was a boy, Kuhe had a market, a tea house and a stone bridge with lions on it. I mean to see all of that again before my hands give out.

quests.title: Who pays for all this work?
dialog: The caravans do, in a way. Every merchant who sleeps here leaves a few coins, a sack of lime or a load of timber from the ferry. It is slow, but it is more than we had before the new road. Even people who left for Hotan send money now. Some say they will come back when the roofs are done.

quests.title: Do you remember me?
dialog: See the wall on the mountain side? Fire-stone, every block. When the mountain shakes, that wall will be the last thing standing.

quests.title: Stone That Has Seen Fire
dialog: The new wall on the mountain side is my pride - and my worry. Every time Chiyan shakes, ordinary stone cracks like a dry biscuit. But stone that has been through the fire does not crack. The Magma Cyclops on the slopes are made of it - those were lizards once, and the mountain baked them into living rock. Bring me 60 blocks of Fire-Hardened Stone. Only a clean break gives a block I can use, so they will come to you only once you agree to help.
Good. The Magma Cyclops wander the slopes just outside the village - you will not have to walk far. About one in four will leave a block worth carrying.
Then I will keep patching the cracks after every tremor. Mind the stones on your way out.
Not enough yet. 60 blocks of Fire-Hardened Stone - the wall is long, and the mountain is patient.
Your pack is too full for what I have for you. Make some room and come back.

Feel the weight of it - and still warm inside. With these blocks the mountain side of the wall will hold when Chiyan shakes. Take this. When the market and the tea house stand again, there will be a stone in them with your name on it.
You have the stone. Return to Mason Zhou Kang on the square of Kuhe Village.

quests.title: Do you really travel to Suzhou?
dialog: Now and then. Silk goes west, rare things come back east - and nobody asks too many questions. If you are looking for something you cannot find in a city shop, you came to the right man.

quests.title: Sapphire Dragon Flag
quests.mission: Bring 300,000,000 gold and 3 Gold Dragon Flags (in your inventory) to Merchant Yee-Wish (Nanzhang or Hotan)
quests.rewards: Experience 49662021 / SP 4000 / Sapphire Dragon Flag (Str +5, Int +5, Damage +1%, Max HP +2%) / Sapphire Dragon Flag attachment (Menu > Outfit)
dialog: I can help you get a Sapphire Dragon Flag. But it is a rare item, especially in these parts - so it is expensive. Bring me 3 Gold Dragon Flags and pay 300,000,000 gold.
Bring the 3 Gold Dragon Flags in your inventory and the gold with you, then talk to me.
Your loss. A flag like this does not wait for long.
Come back when you have 300,000,000 gold and 3 Gold Dragon Flags.
Make some room in your inventory and talk to me again.
Do you have 300,000,000 gold and 3 Gold Dragon Flags for me?
Not now, friend. Come back a little later.
A pleasure doing business. Here is your Sapphire Dragon Flag. The Sapphire Dragon Flag attachment is waiting for you in Menu > Outfit.

quests.title: The Trees That Walk
dialog: Hu Lan bound the tigers with his oath - fire in their claws, frost in their breath, poison in their fangs. But an oath that strong did not stop where it was meant to. It woke the old trees in the forest south of the city. The Ancient and Elder Yeoha stood rooted there for a thousand years; then they began to walk, each with a spirit caught inside that could not sleep. Every evening we still pray for the ones that walk.

quests.title: Why do the old trees walk?
dialog: Because they heard something they should not have. Trees listen - slowly, over hundreds of years. When Hu Lan swore his oath in the forest, the earth carried his words to every root. The tigers answered first, then the wasps in the hills, and last of all the oldest trees, who are slow in everything. They tore their roots from the ground and began to walk. Where to? I think they are looking for the one who woke them.

quests.title: Do you remember me?
dialog: The south forest whispers less since you walked through it. Peace be with you - you brought it to others first.

quests.title: The Trees That Walk
quests.mission: Put 150 Ancient Yeoha to rest; Put 150 Elder Yeoha to rest
dialog: You have heard how Hu Lan bound the tigers with his oath - fire in their claws, frost in their breath, poison in their fangs. But an oath that strong does not stop where it is meant to. It woke the old trees in the forest south of the city. The Ancient Yeoha and the Elder Yeoha stood rooted there for a thousand years; now they walk, and in each of them a spirit is caught that cannot sleep. We pray for them every evening, but prayer does not cut bark. Release them: a hundred and fifty Ancient Yeoha and a hundred and fifty Elder Yeoha.
Go south, beyond the fields. Where the trees move without wind, you are close. Strike without anger - they did not choose to walk.
Then go in peace. The trees have waited a thousand years; they will wait for someone else.
The south forest still whispers at night. Their spirits are not free yet - a hundred and fifty of each kind.
Your pack is too full for what I have for you. Make some room and come back.

I heard it last night - the forest was silent for the first time since the oath. The spirits have gone to rest. We will burn incense for them at dawn, and for you as well. Peace be with you, traveler. Take this, with the blessing of the temple.
The walking trees are at rest. Return to Monk Deshan at the temple of Nanzhang.

quests.title: The lanterns stopped dancing.
dialog: Already? Let me look at you... Hm, your eyes are clear again. Shall we finish the pipe?

Easy... breathe in... hold it... Now look at the lanterns. See? The graves are smiling at us. Or that is the herb. Either way, you look wiser already - and your head feels lighter, eh? Same place tomorrow. Bring herbs. And the ten million... we will talk about that tomorrow as well.
Lanterns? What lanterns? Sit down with me first and we will see - one pipe a day, and not one puff more.

quests.title: Why do you live among the graves?
dialog: Why? Look around, friend! No rent. No neighbours banging on the wall. Nobody asks when I will pay back the hundred gold - they have all stopped asking. Hic. I had a house once, near the Jade Dice hall. Then I had a very good night at the tables, followed by a very bad one. The cemetery took me in. The dead are the best company in Nanzhang: they listen, they never interrupt, and my creditors are far too scared of ghosts to come looking for me here.

quests.title: Do you remember me?
dialog: Ah, my favourite drinking companion! Sit, sit - the dead do not mind, and neither do I. The ten million? Next week. Definitely next week.

quests.title: Ten Million Reasons
dialog: Psst. Come here. Closer. You look like someone who can keep a secret... and swing a blade. Up in the Old Mining Camp the bandits grow a little herb. A very special herb. Very... medicinal. Bring me four hundred and twenty bundles and I will make you rich. Ten million gold! Plus the experience, of course. Nieckarz always pays. Well. Nieckarz always means to pay.
The bandits in the Old Mining Camp carry it in their pouches - every second one has a bundle. They will not hand it over nicely, so do not ask nicely. And do not smoke it on the way back!
Your loss, friend. Ten million gold, walking away on two legs... Hic.
Four hundred and twenty, I said. I can count. Mostly. That is not four hundred and twenty.
Your pack is full. Throw out something useless. Like your savings.

Four hundred and twenty! Beautiful. Look at them. Smell them! Now, about the ten million... You see, there is a situation. A small one. Temporary. The moment I finish... this business, I will have the gold, and then I owe you. Tomorrow. First thing. Word of Nieckarz! In the meantime - sit down with me. We smoke a little of this, just to test the quality. Professional duty.
That is the lot! Back to Nieckarz at the cemetery - the ten million is waiting. Probably.
Easy, easy! One run a day, friend. My nose can only take so much... and my debts too. Come back tomorrow.

quests.title: Sit Down and Smoke
dialog: You still here? Good, good. Sit down on that stone - the owner will not mind, he has been dead for a hundred years. Here, my finest blend. Consider it an advance on the ten million.
Easy... breathe in... hold it... Now look at the lanterns. Talk to me when they stop dancing.
Suit yourself. More for me.
Shhh... not yet. The smoke is still telling me something important.

See? The graves are smiling at us. Or that is the herb. Either way, you look wiser already - and your head feels lighter, eh? Same place tomorrow. Bring herbs. And the ten million... we will talk about that tomorrow as well.
Shhh... not yet. The smoke is still telling me something important.
One pipe a day, my friend - even I have rules. Well, one rule. Come back tomorrow with herbs.

quests.title: What do you see at night?
quests.mission: Conversation with Night Watchman Bao Deng
dialog: Lights on the slopes of Chiyan. Pale figures walking slowly between the rocks, always uphill, always toward the crater. Some look like people from this valley who died in the eruption. They never answer when you call, and by morning there are no footprints.

quests.title: Do the spirits come down here?
quests.mission: Conversation with Night Watchman Bao Deng
dialog: Not yet. They keep to the mountain, as if something up there holds them on a leash. But every year they walk a little lower. That is why the lamps never go out in Kuhe, and why I never sleep before the sun is up.

quests.title: A Line of Light
quests.mission: Conversation with Night Watchman Bao Deng
dialog: Every year the pale figures on the slopes walk a little lower. One night I saw them by the old goat pen - closer than ever. The lamps hold them back, but lamp oil is only oil. Hui Jing blesses the salt he draws around the houses, and the smoke turns away from us. Now he blesses the oil too, jar by jar, before dusk. Every lamp in Kuhe is a line they cannot cross.

quests.title: Do you remember me?
quests.mission: Conversation with Night Watchman Bao Deng
dialog: The blessed lamps burn steadier than the old ones. Last night the pale walkers stopped at the edge of the light and turned back.

quests.title: A Line of Light
quests.mission: Talk to Shrine Keeper Hui Jing
dialog: Every year the pale figures on the slopes walk a little lower. Last night I saw them by the old goat pen - closer than ever. The lamps hold them back, I am sure of it. But lamp oil is only oil. Hui Jing blesses the salt he draws around the houses, and the smoke turns away from us. If he blessed the oil too, every lamp in Kuhe would be a line they cannot cross. He does not leave the shrine on the hill, and I do not leave my lamps. Will you carry my request up to him?
Thank you. The shrine is on the hill - follow the smell of incense. Tell him the lamps must be lit before dusk.
Then I will just pour more oil and hope. Mind the lamps on your way.
Has Hui Jing given his answer? The shrine is on the hill - follow the smell of incense.

Bao Deng sent you? Bless that stubborn man - he has not slept a full night in years. He is right. Salt holds back the smoke, and oil blessed the same way will hold the light. Tell him to bring the jars to the shrine before dusk; I will pray over every one of them. Take this for climbing the hill - few strangers do.
Go on, the shrine is on the hill. I would go myself, but if I leave the lamps, who will watch them?

quests.title: Was there really a river here?
quests.mission: Conversation with Old Boatman Lu Ping
dialog: A wide one, cold and green, full of carp and reeds. Herons stood in the shallows, and in spring the water came up to the doors of the lowest houses. The whole valley lived on it - fields, orchards, goats and people. That dry ditch under the bridge was its bed.

quests.title: Where did the water go?
quests.mission: Conversation with Old Boatman Lu Ping
dialog: When the mountain burst, the springs in the hills boiled and then fell silent. In one summer the river shrank to a stream, in the next to mud, then to cracked stone. Now nothing flows from the mountain but the evil that seeps from its cracks. I still keep the boat. Rivers have come back before.

quests.title: Do you remember me?
quests.mission: Conversation with Old Fisherman Bai Shou
dialog: Eh, it is you! My walls are warm, my smokehouse is full, and even my old woman has stopped complaining. Ha!

quests.title: Before the Frost Comes
quests.mission: Conversation with Old Fisherman Bai Shou
dialog: Winter comes early to this water. Every year the wind finds a new crack in my walls, and every year I am a little older and a little colder. The white tigers that prowl beyond the ruins wear the warmest coats in all the Nanzhang wilds - their hides line my walls now, and their meat, salted and smoked over the fire, carries me through to spring. Skin a tiger clean and the meat is spoiled; butcher it and the hide is torn. Never both.

quests.title: What the Pond Does Not Stop
quests.mission: Conversation with Old Fisherman Bai Shou
dialog: The tigers are afraid of water - that is why my mother brought me out here, and that is why I am still alive. The pond has been my wall all my life. But the Bog Dragon Turtles love water. They used to climb out onto my island at night and gnaw at the old bridge, and once a big one with a shell like a cart tried my door. A wall of water keeps out only those who fear it.

quests.title: Doesn't the loneliness weigh on you?
quests.mission: Conversation with Old Fisherman Bai Shou
dialog: Lonely? Oh, it weighs on me, some nights more than others. But luckily I still have my wife, there in the bed. She is cold now, hard and bony, but she keeps me company through the lonely, chilly nights. And she never once complains about my snoring.

quests.title: Aren't the tigers a danger to you here?
quests.mission: Conversation with Old Fisherman Bai Shou
dialog: The tigers? Ha! Look at them, pacing along the far shore. Hu Lan twisted those beasts into demons, and like every demon they fear the water. Not one of them has ever set a paw on my bridge. So the pond is my wall. They prowl around it all night long, but they never cross. Out here on my little island, old Bai Shou sleeps sounder than a lord behind his city walls.

quests.title: Before the Frost Comes
quests.mission: Collect 50 Frost Tiger Hides; Collect 20 cuts of Frost Tiger Meat
dialog: Winter comes early to this water. Every year the wind finds a new crack in my walls, and every year I am a little older and a little colder. The white tigers that prowl beyond the ruins wear the warmest coats in all of the Nanzhang wilds. Fifty of their hides would line my walls and the roof over my bed, and twenty good cuts of their meat, salted and smoked over the fire, would carry me through to spring. My hunting days are long gone. Will you bring them to me? The hides and the meat will come to you only once you agree.

The Mystic Frost Tigers roam the meadow all around the pond. One beast in five will give you a hide worth keeping, and another one in five a good cut of meat - but never both from the same tiger. Skin it clean and the meat is spoiled; butcher it and the hide is torn.
I understand. I have lived through more winters on this island than I can count. Perhaps I will live through one more.
Not yet. Fifty hides and twenty cuts of meat - the winter wind does not bargain, and neither can I.
Your pack is too full for what I have for you. Make some room and come back.

Fifty white hides... and meat enough to last until the ice breaks on the pond. Tonight I will sleep warm for the first time in years - and so will my wife. Take this. It is not much, but an old fisherman pays his debts. May the road to the city be kinder to you than it was to me.
You have the hides and the meat. Return to Old Fisherman Bai Shou on the island in the pond.

quests.title: What the Pond Does Not Stop
quests.mission: Hunt 150 Bog Dragon Turtles; Slay 1 Bog Dragon Turtle Champion
dialog: Eh? Sit, sit, stranger. Let me tell you something about my pond. The tigers are afraid of water - that is why my mother brought me out here, and that is why I am still alive. The pond has been my wall all my life. But the Bog Dragon Turtles love water. At night they climb out onto my island and gnaw at the old bridge, and last week one of them tried my door - a big one, with a shell like a cart. Would you thin them out? A hundred and fifty, and the big one. My old bridge cannot take much more.
They lie in the shallows all around the pond, sixty paces from my hut - you cannot miss them. The big one sleeps on the far shore by day. And mind the bridge on your way out!
Eh, I understand. Turtles are slow, but so am I. We will see who wins.
They still come at night - I hear the bridge creaking. A hundred and fifty, and the big one.
Your pack is too full for what an old man has to give. Make some room and come back.

Quiet. Last night not one claw on the bridge - I slept like a log, and my wife says she did too. The tigers keep away from the water, and now the turtles keep away from me. Take this, friend - it is not much, but an old fisherman pays his debts.
The turtles are thinned. Return to Old Fisherman Bai Shou on the island in the pond.

quests.title: Who do you write letters for?
quests.mission: Conversation with Old Scribe Gu Wen
dialog: Farmers to their sons in the army, widows to the tax office, lovers to lovers. Yesterday a beggar dictated a letter to the Emperor himself. I wrote it in my finest hand - every word deserves that, even if no one will ever read it.

quests.title: Where are your parents?
dialog: Mother got the coughing sickness last winter. Father went south to find work and never came back. I wait here by the road he left on, so he can find me when he returns.

quests.title: I would like to become a citizen of Nanzhang
quests.mission: Conversation with Palace Steward Bai Yun
dialog: A citizen of Nanzhang? Many ask, few finish. The city asks six things of you, one after another: help the people of Nanzhang with their troubles, hunt the tigers that threaten our roads, bring tribute from the Forest of Whispers, work for the city, learn its lands - and pay your tax. Do all of it, and the Emperor himself will seal your citizenship. Come to me for each task in turn.

quests.title: Can anyone see the Emperor?
quests.mission: Conversation with Palace Steward Bai Yun
dialog: Anyone may ask. Few are received. Every petition comes to me first - hundreds each season - and I decide which of them reach the great hall. The Emperor and the council meet at dawn; if your name is on my list by then, you may be called up the white steps. If not, you wait for the next season. Bring something worth his time, keep your weapon sheathed and your voice low.

quests.title: Do you remember me?
quests.mission: Conversation with Palace Steward Bai Yun
dialog: Lady Shen's petition sits on top of the pile now - I put it there myself. The Emperor reads the top of the pile.

quests.title: Helping the Residents
quests.mission: Finish 6 different quests for the people of Nanzhang (quests done before also count)
dialog: A citizen first serves the people of the city. Nanzhang is full of those who need a helping hand - priests, merchants, healers, old women and young widows. Finish six different tasks for the people of Nanzhang. Whatever you have already done for them counts too - the city remembers.
Good. Every task you finish for the people of the city brings you closer. Come back when six of them speak well of you.
Then you are not ready to be a citizen. Come back when you are.
Six different tasks for the people of Nanzhang - the city is still waiting for some of them.
Make some room in your inventory and talk to me again.
Six families of Nanzhang speak your name with gratitude. That is how a citizen begins. The next task is waiting for you.
The people of Nanzhang are grateful. Return to Palace Steward Bai Yun at the Imperial Palace.

quests.title: Monsters Hunting for the Crown
dialog: The tigers around Nanzhang grow bolder every year. They attack caravans, hunters and even the farms outside the walls. The Crown asks every future citizen to hunt for it. Kill one hundred tigers around the city - any kind will do: Mystic, Young, Blood, Frost or Poison tigers.
The tigers roam all around the city - in the hills, the woods and by the roads. One hundred of them, for the Crown.
The tigers will not wait for you. Come back when you are ready to hunt.
The tigers still roam around the city. One hundred, for the Crown.
Make some room in your inventory and talk to me again.
One hundred tigers! The roads around Nanzhang are safer today because of you. The Crown thanks you.
You have hunted one hundred tigers. Return to Palace Steward Bai Yun at the Imperial Palace.

quests.title: Tribute
quests.mission: Collect 25 Woodcutter's Axes in the Forest of Whispers
dialog: Every citizen pays tribute to the city. Ours is unusual - we need axes. The woodcutters of the Forest of Whispers lost their axes when the beasts drove them from the clearings. The Tormentors, the Yeoha and the Dreadmaws carry them off. Bring twenty-five of them back to the workshops of Nanzhang.
The Forest of Whispers lies east of the city. Hunt the Forest Tormentors, the Yeoha and the Dreadmaws - about one in four carries an axe.
The workshops will wait. Come back when you are ready.
Twenty-five axes from the Forest of Whispers. The workshops are still waiting.
Make some room in your inventory and talk to me again.
Twenty-five axes - the workshops of Nanzhang will ring again. Your tribute is accepted.
You have the axes. Return to Palace Steward Bai Yun at the Imperial Palace.

quests.title: Work for the City
quests.mission: Finish 2 daily job quests for any job (only quests finished after you accepted this quest count)
dialog: Nanzhang lives from its caravans. Traders carry its goods, hunters guard the roads and even thieves keep the guards awake. Work for the city: finish two daily job quests - for any job you have. Caravan Master Bao Long gives them out every day.
Two daily job quests, for any job. Only the ones you finish from now on count.
The caravans will leave without you. Come back when you want to work.
Two daily job quests - the city is still waiting for your work.
Make some room in your inventory and talk to me again.
The caravan masters speak well of you. A citizen who works for the city is worth ten who only talk.
You have worked for the city. Return to Palace Steward Bai Yun at the Imperial Palace.

quests.title: Know the Land
quests.mission: Find 1 Explorer in the lands of Nanzhang (already found = done)
dialog: A citizen must know the lands of the city. Explorer Gisaeng Ahjin and her companions camp in the wild places around Nanzhang - by old ruins, in the forests and on the ridges. Find one of their camps in the lands of Nanzhang and speak with the Explorer. If you have already found one, the city knows it.
The Explorers camp in the wild places around the city. Speak with one of them in the lands of Nanzhang.
The lands of Nanzhang will wait. Come back when you want to explore.
